'''Tea''' is one of the many genera of trees found above ground. Like the vast majority of above ground trees, tea [[wood]] is brown and produces brown products.

Unfortunately, there is no current way to make tea out of the fallen leaves.

Some [[Dwarf|dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] tea trees for their ''leaves''.
